mapper.select: SELECT plant_name AS plantName, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND( (COUNT(*) * 100.0) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2 ) AS ratio FROM plant_manage WHERE del_flag = 0 GROUP BY plant_name ORDER BY count DESC;
